description: SKELETON of the user's own Pixel Buds Pro 2. Only values recorded in the user's research notes are filled in; everything else is marked unknown. Not a faithful clone until the unknown fields are captured from the real device.
name: Pixel Buds Pro 2

local_name.note: The device name is 'Pixel Buds Pro 2', but the name carried in the advertising payload was not recorded.

service_data.note: ASCS general announcement; notes record sink contexts 0x0fff and source contexts 0x0243 but not the payload bytes.

advertising.note: The real buds use extended advertising (props 0x0001) from a rotating RPA; this emulator uses legacy advertising from a fixed address.

gatt.note: GAP (1800) and GATT (1801) are added automatically. The real device has 15 services / 48 characteristics; only the UUIDs listed here were recorded. Values and most properties were never read.

characteristics.name: Head tracker report (input report 1, 13 bytes)
characteristics.note: The real device produced 0 notifications over GATT after control 03 00. No frame was ever recorded. Use send_scripted_notifications to inject synthetic or later-captured frames.

services.name: Battery
services.note: Present on the real device; characteristic list and values not recorded.

characteristics.name: PnP ID
characteristics.note: Notes give VID 0x00E0 PID 0x3005 version 0x0100 (modalias v00E0p3005d0100) but not the GATT byte value, so none is set.

characteristics.name: Firmware Revision String
characteristics.note: Firmware 'release_5.203' was reported over RFCOMM, not this characteristic; not set as a value.

characteristics.name: ASE Control Point
characteristics.note: Notes say 'write/notify'; the exact write type is not recorded.

characteristics.name: Source Audio Locations
characteristics.note: Notes: one Source Audio Location declared (Front Left); bytes not recorded.

a2dp_sink.note: Capabilities not recorded. Notes only say the phone's A2DP link switches AAC to Opus 48 kHz during spatialized playback.

hid.note: BR/EDR HID head tracker (#AndroidHeadTracker#1.0) as seen on the Pixel 7a; L2CAP PSM 0x11/0x13. Not emulated.

rfcomm_services.name: BTIS
rfcomm_services.note: connection refused on the real device

provenance.name: pixel-buds-pro-2-headtracking.md (sensor entry); sound-retry/docs/research/pixel-buds-pro-2-mic-2026-09-22.md (title)
provenance.address: 10:D9:A2:48:20:7D from sound-retry/docs/research/pixel-buds-pro-2-mic-2026-09-22.md header and pixel-buds-pro-2-headtracking.md section (e). This is the real buds' identity address; override with device_create(address=...) to avoid sharing it.
provenance.appearance: 'Earbud' from sound-retry/docs/research/linux-le-audio-headtracking.md (LE advertising row). Numeric 0x0941 is the Bluetooth SIG assigned value for Earbud, derived while writing this skeleton, not read from the device.
provenance.advertising.service_data: UUIDs 184E/184F/1853/1855 from sound-retry/docs/research/linux-le-audio-headtracking.md (ASCS general announcement, BASS, CAS, TMAP service data). Payload bytes not recorded.
provenance.gatt service and characteristic UUIDs: sound-retry/docs/research/pixel-buds-pro-2-mic-2026-09-22.md Appendix B (B.1 service map; B.2 ASCS, MICS, TMAP, DIS and PACS tables). 1800/1801 omitted (auto-added). Properties for ASE (read,notify), ASE control point (write,notify) and MICS Mute (read,write,notify) from the same tables; PACS/TMAP/DIS properties not recorded.
provenance.head tracker version value: Live GATT read 2026-09-23 recorded in sound-retry/docs/research/s2-00-headtracker-stream.md: '#AndroidHeadTracker#2.0#2' + 00 x8 + 'BT' + 10 d9 a2 48 20 7d (transport capability 2 = ISO only).
provenance.head tracker control value: Same file: read 00 00 (off). Writing 03 00 was accepted and stored; 0 notifications followed.
provenance.classic_info: HID VID/PID and PSMs from pixel-buds-pro-2-headtracking.md section (b); RFCOMM UUID/channel table and firmware release_5.203 from sound-retry/docs/research/pixel-buds-pro-2-mic-2026-09-22.md.
